summary: Mobile dark-mode readability audit (AUDIT ONLY — no fixes applied). Combined source-code sweep for hardcoded palette colours + on-device screenshot verification (Expo web preview at 390x844 with cathy@example.com/testpass123). Confirmed the audit's premise: several mobile screens bypass useTheme() and paint dark-teal / dark-clay / dark-sage / dark-red text and backgrounds that were designed for the LIGHT palette. On the dark bg (#06201F) those hardcoded values either vanish into the background (P0) or fail WCAG AA contrast (P1). A quick light-mode sanity pass on About, Timeline and AI Tools confirmed all findings are dark-only — light mode renders correctly, so every fix must be gated on isDark or use the colors.* tokens. The letter 'paper' preview (letters/[id].tsx lf1-preview-paper) is intentionally white; NOT flagged. Deprecated packages detected: none new. React Native issues detected: none beyond the reported dark-mode colour hardcoding.

ui_bugs.issue: P0 INVISIBLE CARD: TILES = ['#0E4D52','#A5512B','#425F47'] painted as backgroundColor on tool cards. #0E4D52 (light-mode brand teal) is virtually identical to dark bg #06201F — the 1st tile ('Statement Decoder', 4th tile, 7th tile …) melts into the background and only its white text is visible. #425F47 (sage) is also very close to bg. Should use colors.primary / colors.gold / colors.sage which shift to lighter tones in dark. Reference: /app/mobile/app/(tabs)/ai-tools.tsx:45,120,128

ui_bugs.component: Timeline — event dot icon & card accent
ui_bugs.issue: P1 low-contrast + P2 disappearing icons. TINT map uses light-palette darks (#0E4D52, #A5512B, #425F47, #C0392B, #B7791F). Dot icon colour is set to `tint` on a `tint + '0D'` (6% alpha) fill, and the card gets `borderLeftColor: tint` + `backgroundColor: tint + '0D'`. On dark bg #06201F: statement/care_plan/calendar/letter icons (dark teal #0E4D52 and dark sage #425F47) become nearly invisible against the near-black card fill; card left-border stripe is also unreadable. Should map each event type to a colors.* token or a dark-mode-aware lighter tint. Reference: /app/mobile/app/timeline.tsx:41-50,218,224-225,229

P1 low-contrast. 14 hardcoded dark hexes for chips / dots / month-view dots (e.g. #0E4D52, #12707A, #2E6E83, #4E6E54, #6B8F71 sage400, #6E6459, #7A6450, #3F7CAC, #8A6D3B). Multiple values fall below 3:1 on #06201F (dark teal/sage/brown ≈ 2.0–3.5:1). Also textDisabledColor picks #3A5150 for out-of-month days — barely readable. Should route through a per-type token map that returns lighter shades in dark. Reference: /app/mobile/app/calendar.tsx:26-40,232

P1 low-contrast. SectionHeading paints the roman-numeral ('I', 'II', …) and the 40x3 accent bar with BRAND.clay '#A5512B' unconditionally. On dark bg the ratio is ~3.4:1 for 16pt semibold, marginal for AA. Also breaks parity — dark mode should switch to colors.gold '#E89A6F'. Reference: /app/mobile/app/about.tsx:31-37,241-242

ui_bugs.component: About — stat tiles + Panel bg (Section III)
ui_bugs.issue: P1 near-invisible tile edge. StatTile for '3 Budget Streams' uses bg '#0E4D52' (BRAND.teal), which is one shade off the dark bg — the tile silhouette disappears; only the white value is visible, making the three-tile row look like floating text. Same happens to any Panel bg=BRAND.teal (Hero, Pull-Quote, 'Ask Wayly' panel, Antony's note). Should ramp teal panels to colors.surface2 or a lighter teal in dark. Reference: /app/mobile/app/about.tsx:97-99,51-73,151-160,172-187

P2 out-of-place bright white pill. ctaPrimary uses backgroundColor '#fff' with color BRAND.clay — a pure-white button on the dark-teal panel & dark app background. Every other button on this screen is themed. Should use a themed light-on-dark treatment (e.g. colors.surface with colors.text) or the theme cta token. Reference: /app/mobile/app/about.tsx:386-396,199-206

P2 bright white pill on dark card. backgroundColor '#fff' painted unconditionally for the count badge; text inside uses whatever colour is default. On dark bg the pill glows white and clashes with the rest of the themed dashboard tiles. Should use colors.surface / colors.gold. Reference: /app/mobile/app/(tabs)/index.tsx:354

ui_bugs.component: CHSP Tools — 'Apply For Hardship / Fee Waiver' button
ui_bugs.issue: P1 out-of-theme dark clay. Button applies inline backgroundColor '#A5512B' (light-mode clay) instead of the theme cta token. In dark the theme cta = '#A5512B' happens to match, so it's cosmetically OK but breaks the pattern; more importantly it locks the value regardless of theme. Reference: /app/mobile/app/chsp-tools.tsx:89

ui_bugs.component: CHSP Tools — 'Billed vs Expected' amount tiles
ui_bugs.issue: P1 low-contrast numbers. Amount rendering hardcodes '#C0392B' / '#0E4D52' / '#3E6A4C' for the value text. On dark bg, #0E4D52 (dark teal) is essentially bg-colour → the 'Billed'/'Expected' numbers vanish when the delta is <= 0, and '#3E6A4C' sage is ~2.4:1. Reference: /app/mobile/app/chsp-tools.tsx:328

P1 first swatch invisible. COLOR_SWATCHES = ['#0E2A47','#2BC4D6','#7C9B82','#C76B5A','#5F4E76']. The first swatch (#0E2A47 dark navy) is nearly indistinguishable from dark bg #06201F — user cannot see it as an option or a chosen state. Reference: /app/mobile/app/participants.tsx:16

P2 cosmetic parity. Hardcoded tones '#8FBF95', '#F0B267', '#A3CBCC', '#F0857A', '#F0B267' (lines 68,177-180). Contrast is acceptable on both themes because these are already light tones, but they never re-tone from the theme — dark-mode Robert/Patricia bars look identical to light which is visually 'washed out' on the darker card. Should route through colors.success / colors.gold / colors.primary / colors.terracotta. Reference: /app/mobile/app/participant/[id].tsx:68,177-180

P2 acceptable but not tokenised. color '#E89A6F' hardcoded on hero H1. Happens to equal dark-mode colors.gold so it's readable, but it will look wrong in LIGHT mode (light-mode clay is #A5512B) — quick light-mode sanity screenshot showed the pale peach text on the teal panel looks under-baked. Should use theme token or a per-theme value. Reference: /app/mobile/app/about.tsx:54

issues: First tile per row (Statement Decoder / 4th tool / 7th tool) uses backgroundColor #0E4D52 which is ~ΔE 3 from the app bg #06201F — cards blend into the background, only white text visible.

Icon inside coloured dot is unreadable for statement / care_plan / calendar / letter events because dark-teal or dark-sage icon on 6%-alpha-of-the-same-colour circle on dark bg = essentially monochrome dark on dark.
Left-accent stripe on cards is invisible for the same reason.
Legend chips and month-view dots for GP, Specialist, Allied Health, Nurse, Home Visit, Telehealth, Transport, Personal, Other are all sub-3:1 on dark bg; users cannot distinguish event types.
Out-of-month calendar cell text (#3A5150) too dark against dark bg.
Roman numeral markers ('I', 'II', 'III', …) and the 3px orange accent bar use #A5512B which is a marginal-contrast dark clay; less legible than the light-mode counterpart.
'Budget Streams / Levels / Began' stat tile with bg #0E4D52 has no visible edge — the row appears to be three floating numbers.
'Decode a Statement' CTA is a pure-white pill inside a teal panel — jarring in dark mode.
'Someone Had To.' peach text works in dark but the same code path renders in light mode with the same peach — a light-mode inconsistency exposed by the audit.
'Billed' and 'Expected' amount numbers vanish when the delta is negative because the winning colour is #0E4D52 (dark teal on near-black bg).
Amount-tile row lacks a visible label separator in dark; only the label text carries.
'Things to know' bright-white count badge is out of place on the themed dark cards.
Colour picker: first swatch #0E2A47 (dark navy) reads as 'empty slot' on dark bg.

parity_issues.flow: Dark mode readability parity with web
parity_issues.issue: Web dark-mode sweep (iter 354-358) is complete; mobile has NOT yet replaced hardcoded palette colours listed above. Every offender is a light-mode value baked into JSX/StyleSheet rather than colors.* from useTheme(). Web + mobile theme tokens already match (tokens.ts mirrors :root and html.theme-dark).
parity_issues.expected: Every element that has a distinct value in tokens.ts should read from useTheme().colors.* on mobile just as it reads from CSS custom props on web.
parity_issues.actual: About / Timeline / Calendar / AI Tools / CHSP / Participants / Participant detail / Dashboard still contain 40+ hardcoded palette hexes (see ui_bugs list).

Timeline: turn TINT into a function `(colors) => ({...})` returning the correct token per event type (statement -> colors.primary, invoice -> colors.gold, chat/care_plan -> colors.sage, hospital -> colors.terracotta, budget_alert -> colors.alert) and remove the fallback '#0E4D52'. Reference: /app/mobile/app/timeline.tsx:41-50,218.

(b) Panel bg's BRAND.teal → in dark, use a lifted teal like colors.surface2 (#14403F) so tiles have a visible edge. (c) ctaPrimary bg '#fff' → use `colors.surface` in dark. critical_code_review_comments: Colour tokens exist and are correct (tokens.ts already mirrors web); the bug class is uniformly 'developer wrote a hex instead of reading colors.*'. Enforce with a lint rule: forbid hex literals inside /app/mobile/app/**/*.tsx except in ThemeContext / tokens.ts.

About screen re-declares BRAND {teal,clay,sage,plum,terra} as a module const — this pattern also exists on web but web is CSS-var-driven. Rewrite BRAND as a hook: `const BRAND = useBrand(colors)` returning theme-aware values.
Timeline+Calendar both use event-type -> colour maps as module constants. Move both maps into hooks so they close over `colors`.
Participant/[id] SpendBar tones already have semantic meaning (good/warn/bad) — should use colors.success / colors.gold / colors.terracotta directly.
Deprecation-noise (unrelated to this audit) surfaced in console: props.pointerEvents deprecated, Image.style.tintColor deprecated, Image.style.resizeMode deprecated — worth a housekeeping ticket.

context_for_next_testing_agent: This is iteration 359 dark-mode mobile audit (AUDIT ONLY — sibling to web iter 354-358). Report lists every hardcoded palette hex found in /app/mobile/app/**/*.tsx grouped by severity. Next agent should: (1) re-run the same dark screen sweep (AI Tools, Timeline, Calendar, About, Dashboard, CHSP, Participants, Participant/[id]) after main agent applies fixes; (2) verify the P0 AI-Tools invisible-card issue is gone by asserting each ai-tool-card-* background has ΔE > 8 from #06201F; (3) run a light-mode regression on About + AI Tools since fixes may swing colours the wrong way; (4) do NOT flag lf1-preview-paper white paper — intentional; (5) letters/[id] lines 1304-1336 are inside the paper preview only — leave alone. Screenshots taken this run live under .screenshots/dark_audit/.
rca of the issue: Root cause: several mobile screens ship module-level colour constants (e.g. `const BRAND = {…}`, `const TILES = […]`, `const TINT: Record<string,string> = {…}`) or inline `backgroundColor: '#fff'` values, all of which snapshot the LIGHT palette at module-load time. Because they never re-read from useTheme().colors.*, they are frozen to the light values regardless of `isDark`. When the user flips to Dark in Settings, the theme context updates colors.* everywhere they are used through useTheme(), but these module constants keep their light values — producing 3 failure modes: (a) dark-on-dark invisibility when the frozen colour ≈ dark bg (#0E4D52 vs #06201F, #0E2A47 vs #06201F), (b) sub-3:1 low contrast when a dark clay/sage/red sits on the dark bg, and (c) 'bright card in dark mode' artefacts when a #fff or light-cream is baked into a pill/tile/chip. Mitigation is uniform: replace every hardcoded palette hex with the corresponding colors.* token read from the useTheme() hook, or (for maps that need per-item colour) convert the map into a function/hook that closes over colors.
